scripts.start:local: bash -lc 'set -o pipefail; mkdir -p .agent/logs; WATCHPACK_POLLING=true NG_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS=12 ng serve myscoutee --configuration local 2>&1 | tee .agent/logs/ng-serve-local.log'
scripts.start:dev: bash -lc 'set -o pipefail; mkdir -p .agent/logs; WATCHPACK_POLLING=true NG_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS=12 ng serve myscoutee --configuration dev 2>&1 | tee .agent/logs/ng-serve-dev.log'
scripts.start:e2e: bash -lc 'set -o pipefail; mkdir -p .agent/logs; WATCHPACK_POLLING=true NG_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS=12 ng serve myscoutee --configuration e2e 2>&1 | tee .agent/logs/ng-serve-e2e.log'
scripts.start:nolog: WATCHPACK_POLLING=true NG_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS=12 ng serve myscoutee --configuration local
scripts.start:prod: bash -lc 'set -o pipefail; mkdir -p .agent/logs; WATCHPACK_POLLING=true NG_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS=12 ng serve myscoutee --configuration production-serve 2>&1 | tee .agent/logs/ng-serve-prod.log'
scripts.build:github: NG_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS=12 ng build myscoutee --configuration github --base-href /myscoutee/ && FRONTEND_BUILD_OUTPUT_DIR=docs FRONTEND_BUILD_PROFILE=standalone node scripts/stamp-prod-build.js && touch docs/.nojekyll
scripts.build:log: bash -lc 'set -o pipefail; mkdir -p .agent/logs; NG_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS=12 ng build myscoutee --configuration local 2>&1 | tee .agent/logs/ng-build-local.log'
scripts.build:prod: NG_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS=12 ng build myscoutee --configuration production && FRONTEND_BUILD_OUTPUT_DIR=prod node scripts/stamp-prod-build.js
scripts.build:prod:log: bash -lc 'set -o pipefail; mkdir -p .agent/logs; NG_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS=12 ng build myscoutee --configuration production 2>&1 | tee .agent/logs/ng-build-prod.log && FRONTEND_BUILD_OUTPUT_DIR=prod node scripts/stamp-prod-build.js 2>&1 | tee -a .agent/logs/ng-build-prod.log'
scripts.watch:log: bash -lc 'mkdir -p .agent/logs; NG_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS=12 ng build myscoutee --watch --configuration dev 2>&1 | tee .agent/logs/ng-watch-dev.log'
